🚨🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO HALTS US LIVESTOCK IMPORTS — SCREWWORM OUTBREAK FORCES REVERSE QUARANTINE</u>

Senasica suspended every veterinary import permit (HRZ) for live US cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, horses and select birds after APHIS-USDA notified Mexico on June 4 of a confirmed screwworm infestation in a bovine in Zavala County, Texas — with new cases reported in New Mexico. Baja California, BCS, Chihuahua and Sinaloa stay pest-free, and the 4T agriculture ministry intends to keep it that way.

For decades the US dictated sanitary terms northward. Sovereignty cuts both directions now.

🇲🇽📉 MEXICO'S INFLATION DROPS TO 3.94% — BACK INSIDE BANXICO'S TARGET RANGE

INEGI reports inflation fell to 3.94% in May, down from 4.45% in April — the second consecutive decline and back inside Banxico's 2-4% target band for the first time since January. Monthly prices actually dropped 0.21%. Electricity down 17.88% (summer tariffs), fruits and vegetables down 3.18%, eggs down 4.92%.

While US inflation sits at 3.8% with no rate cuts in sight, Mexico's price stability is doing what macro policy is supposed to do: protect purchasing power.

🚨🇲🇽 CHIHUAHUA POLICE GAVE A .223 RIFLE TO CIA AGENT — THEN COVERED IT UP

The State Investigation Agency provided a .223 caliber rifle to a CIA operative who died alongside AEI director Oseguera in a pickup truck crash in the Sierra Tarahumara on April 18. After the accident, a weapons commander known as "Comandante Vaca" swapped the damaged rifle for another to destroy evidence. The female officer who originally carried the weapon hasn't been questioned.

Foreign agents armed by Mexican state police, operating in sovereign territory without authorization — and the cover-up started before the bodies were cold.

🇲🇽⚽ WORLD CUP INAUGURATION: MEXICO SUSPENDS CLASSES AND ACTIVATES TELEWORK BY FEDERAL DECREE

The DOF published a decree suspending classes at all levels — public and private — in Mexico City and activating remote work for federal and private-sector non-essential activities on inauguration day. Goal: reduce traffic and ensure mobility for residents and visitors.

SoFi Stadium in LA has 2,000 workers on strike three days before their first match. Mexico's approach: plan ahead, put citizens first.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO-US BILATERAL: FENTANYL SEIZURES DOWN 76% UNDER SHEINBAUM

Velasco and Rubio spoke by phone Sunday in what the SRE described as a "cordial and respectful" atmosphere. Bilateral meeting now set for June 12 in Mexico City — security, migration, T-MEC review on the agenda. Key number: fentanyl seizures down 76% since Sheinbaum took office.

Mexico cooperates as a sovereign equal. The results speak for themselves.

🔥🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM: CALDERÓN'S GOVERNMENT PARTNERED WITH THE SINALOA CARTEL

"They associated with the Sinaloa Cartel against other criminal groups — something we would never do." Sheinbaum laid out the record: García Luna convicted in the US for drug trafficking, $65 million diverted through fake security equipment contracts — gear that "either never arrived or was at triple, quadruple, or quintuple the price."

The so-called Drug War was a narco-state selling protection while 350,000 people died.

🚨🌎 US RESUMES BOMBING IRAN AFTER APACHE HELICOPTER DOWNED IN HORMUZ

Trump ordered strikes on Qeshm Island, Sirik, Jask, and Bandar Abbas after Iran downed a US Apache helicopter patrolling the Strait of Hormuz — both pilots survived. CENTCOM called it a "proportional response to unjustified Iranian aggression." Iran says it "will leave no attack or threat unanswered."

This is the same strait the US was supposedly blockading to "contain" Iran. Months into this war: no deal, no leverage, no endgame — just escalation.
📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — 9 de junio de 2026 · Palacio Nacional

Now [under Sheinbaum] it is above 20,000." — Mario Delgado, Education Secretary, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Base monthly salary for a primary-school teacher. The figure more than doubles between the end of neoliberalism and the second year of the Fourth Transformation. Plus 1,100+ teachers reinstated since 2019.
